name: Shimron
overview: Shimron is referenced in Scripture both as a person and a place. As a son of Issachar, Shimron is listed among his brothers, highlighting his role in the genealogical lineage of Israel (Genesis 46:13; Numbers 26:24). Additionally, Shimron is identified as a city within the territory of the tribe of Zebulun, noted among other cities and as a kingdom with its own ruler during the time of Joshua (Joshua 11:1; 19:15). These references emphasize Shimron's significance in Israel's tribal structure and territorial inheritance.
